FeaturesPrivacyPricingPlatformsHelp and legal

Features

Everything a map needs, nothing in the way.

Spend your time thinking, not formatting diagrams. The map stays useful with or without AI.

01

Infinite canvas and outline

Topics lay themselves out automatically on an infinite canvas, or switch to the outline view to write and reorder quickly. Pan, zoom, and undo or redo any step.

02

On-device AI

Apple Intelligence runs on your device to generate a map from a short description, suggest subtopics, brainstorm, suggest tags, summarize a branch and rewrite. Every suggestion is labelled, and you can edit it before you accept it.

03

Ask About This Map

Ask a question about the map you have open and get an answer from the on-device model that cites the topics it used.

04

Notes, links and tags

Add a note to any topic, attach a web link, and tag topics to group related ideas, so a map stays useful as it grows.

05

Import and export

Bring in Markdown and plain text. Export to Markdown, plain text, PNG or PDF, or save a MindMap AI Backup file.

06

Search and organize

Search across all your maps, with or without accents. Keep maps in Favorites and Recent, and restore deleted ones from Recently Deleted.

07

Share menu and Shortcuts

Send text and links to MindMap AI from the Share menu in other apps. Use Shortcuts actions and Spotlight to start a map, add an idea or open a recent map.

08

Connect AI apps on your Mac

Let AI apps such as Claude Code or ChatGPT read your maps through MCP. It is off by default; when you turn it on, each app needs its own token.

Privacy

Data Not Collected

MindMap AI has no account, no analytics, no ads and no tracking. xDev runs no servers for it, and your maps are never sent to xDev.

Read the privacy policy→
  • AI runs on your device with Apple Intelligence.
  • Your maps are stored on your device.
  • AI apps you connect on a Mac can read your maps only after you turn it on.

Mac
